note: Page-time budgets in milliseconds, as the median on the seeded four-times project (make perf-budget). The final budgets are 300 ms per page and 100 ms for the frame share, with no margin. The frame budget applies to the largest frame value across the pages; a page that reads the project session list before its layout does shows a frame of about 0 ms, because the layout takes the shared answer, so that page is held by its own budget.
